timed_region: The interval at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:803-805 encloses qtClustering, including algorithmic preprocessing, device preparation, distributed seed scoring, cluster selection, membership construction and root result assembly.
start_synchronization: Root records its start before entering qtClustering's initial MPI_Allgather. Every rank must receive root's contribution before proceeding to the first algorithmic preprocessing. Consequently, no useful clustering computation can precede root's start, even if another rank records an earlier timestamp.
stop_synchronization: Every scoring stream is synchronized before its score participates in MPI_Allreduce. Any subsequent membership kernel is synchronized before its output is communicated to root or consumed locally by root. Root assembles the final result before stopping. The full-set shortcut similarly synchronizes the selected owner's membership kernel and delivers its complete output to root.
rank_aggregation: Elapsed durations are not reduced. Instead, the initial Allgather and the completed-score/member dependencies establish a root-clock global makespan. The MPI_MAX at line 636 reduces cluster scores, not elapsed times.
reported_value: Only root prints 'Clustering time', using its enclosing interval converted to whole milliseconds. The label, duration and declared unit agree.
semantic_equivalence_basis: This is cooperative computation: workers score disjoint strided seed subsets, global selection combines their scores, and root assembles the clusters. Replicated inputs do not make these independent complete-result replicas. Root's start precedes required computation on all workers, and its stop follows completed scoring and delivery of the final required membership data, establishing the permitted makespan equivalent.

evidence.finding: Every rank brackets qtClustering with timestamps; only root reports the enclosing interval as 'Clustering time' in milliseconds.
The initial worker-count Allgather occurs before finite checks and sorting. Its root contribution is issued after root's start timestamp, gating useful work on every rank.
Point reordering, cutoff calculation, bounding-box detection, search-window construction and device initialization all occur inside the timed call.
firstSeed, stride and seedCount assign each device a seed partition; devices do not independently evaluate every seed.
collect synchronizes the scoring stream, including its result download. readMembers synchronizes the membership kernel and download before returning host members.

All scoring completes before global score selection. Singleton termination needs no further membership kernel; otherwise the selected owner completes readMembers before broadcasting or sending members to root. The full-set shortcut also follows this membership-completion path.
Root converts received members into the final clusters before qtClustering returns and its timer stops.
External result reporting and validation execute after timing; neither flag selects a different clustering implementation.

notes: Applies to the supplied four-rank hybrid benchmark configuration (-n 5000, default threshold 2.0). Device setup and input generation/broadcast precede timing and are permitted initialization. Some allocation and teardown remain inside timing. The supplied target-type evidence establishes that the millisecond count is long, matching %ld; whole-millisecond formatting is valid.
